The official main event Black Friday sales are now live everywhere and the Apple deals are wild at Amazon. Alongside the brilliant deal on AirPods Pro 3 at a wild $100 off, the M5 MacBook Air offers at $400 off, and MacBook Neo models at $100 off, Amazon has also now dropped the price again on the brand new M6 MacBook Pro to deliver new all-time lows at $250 off.

All of that joins the best prices ever across the Apple Watch Series 12 lineup at $100 off, the all-time low on Apple Watch Ultra 4 at $150 off, and the notable $100 price drops on the brand new OLED iPad mini. Head below for all of that as well as AirTag 2 at just $18 Prime shipped, a fresh batch of Anker charging gear, and all of the best Qi2 25W MagSafe charging station deals we have uncovered.

These deals also join a deep discount on Apple latest 2026 AirPods Max at $130 off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $149 (Reg. $249) – Now live again!
  • AirPods Max 2 $419 (Reg. $549) – Now even lower at $130 off

Official AirPods Pro 3 Black Friday deal

The list price on Apple’s new entry AirPods 5 has yet to budge over at Amazon, but that, by and large doesn’t really matter all that much for all that many folks considering you can score the far superior AirPods Pro 3 at the same price.

Regularly $249, Amazon is now offering the world’s greatest wireless active noise cancellation earbuds down at $149 shipped. While Best Buy had finally attempted to match Amazon here with its official main event deal, they are still a touch lower over at Amazon.

A set of the new AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case is selling for the same price as the pro-grade set right now with 3x better noise cancellation, better battery life, a deeper feature set, and, if you ask me, better audio – Black Friday and Black Fridaying, and it is Black Fridaying hard here.

Official AirPods Max 2 Black Friday deal

This Apple finally unleashed a proper next-generation set of AirPods Max 2 – they might look the same at a glance but the Max 2 carries the Apple H2 chip under the hood with an upgraded high dynamic range amplifier, up to 1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation, and a new digital signal processing algorithm that delivers better Transparency Mode.

Regularly $549, these things are now sitting down at $419 shipped for Black Friday 2026 to deliver $130 in savings and one of the best deals we have ever tracked on all five colors.

We did see some of them dip a touch lower to $400 back in the summer, but that deal was hard to land, constantly going in and out of stock on select colorways.

That’s $150 off and $50 under the next best price of 2026. If you’re looking to setup a powerful workstation or upgrade your existing rig, the 26-port FusionDock Ultra is specifically designed to elevate demanding Apple Silicon Mac workstations with support for up to four native 6K displays, 140W charging, 10Gb Ethernet, and a combination of dual-chip architecture and active cooling for stable, dependable performance – scope out our hands-on review for a closer look. If the FusionDock Ultra is a bit overkill for you, the FusionDock Max 2 is a more affordable alternative that still delivers the Thunderbolt 5 and multi-display connectivity you need for a capable Mac workstation – it’s now down at $359.99 from the regular $449.99 for Black Friday.
